data.description:
## Incident Overview
After PR #458 (search_issues includes 'labels') landed and merged with all 5 prior fixes, the labels probe surfaces 2 new gaps:

1. **Inbound differ does NOT exclude 'dso-id:' prefix**: T3 result shows local tags=[dso-id:eeba-3429-9083-44cf, labelprobe-...] — the bridge-internal label leaked into local store. PR #454 added 'dso-id:' to outbound_differ._EXCLUDED_PREFIXES but the inbound side has its own equivalent that still uses the old hyphen form or no exclusion.

2. **3bf8 bidir suppression may be cancelling legitimate outbound ADD**: T1 result regression — was PASS before #458, now FAIL. Outbound add ob-added does not reach Jira even though no offsetting inbound activity should exist. Hypothesis: with #458 labels now in the snapshot, the bidir suppression's cancellation logic is matching outbound ADD vs the spurious inbound REMOVE caused by the snapshot showing 'local has ob-added, jira doesn't' (which it didn't pre-#458 because both sides were []).

## Reproduction
fix/5328-search-labels-field branch + /tmp/labels-probe.sh:
- eeba-3429-9083-44cf ↔ DIG-5022
- T1 OB-ADD: FAIL (jira lacks ob-added after outbound pass)
- T2 OB-REMOVE: PASS
- T3 IB-ADD: FAIL — local has [dso-id:eeba-..., labelprobe-...] (leaked dso-id) but NO ib-added
- T4 IB-REMOVE: vacuous PASS

## Affected Files
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/inbound_differ.py — search for _EXCLUDED_PREFIXES or similar exclusion logic; add 'dso-id:' colon form
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/inbound_differ.py — _build_outbound_context / suppression logic: verify it suppresses spurious inbound mutations only, not legitimate outbound mutations

## Verification
After fix: /tmp/labels-probe.sh — expect T1+T2+T3+T4 ALL PASS with no dso-id leakage in local tags.

**code_version**: a7d2c04b0f562607549ca930f25e02326d7debe4
data.title: [reconciler/differs]: inbound differ leaks dso-id label to local AND bidir suppression cancels legitimate outbound add
